overall_reason: A WebGL game world: a hand-illustrated tiny planet with houses, a lighthouse-orange structure, river and trees in a flat cel-shaded style on a teal void, plus custom side, emoji and checklist UI; nothing resembles a landing-page kit. Confidence is low because the 3D app script was blocked and the capture shows only the intro planet with no text.

findings.evidence: Failed T-FIVE-SECOND (in this capture): the first screen is the planet alone on teal with no visible title, prompt or control; the only words are in the meta description ('It's a small planet, but someone's gotta make the deliveries.'). The 'continue-button' and checklist panels exist in the DOM but render empty.
findings.before: Planet with no on-screen title or start prompt
findings.after: Show the game name 'Messenger' and a 'Click to start' prompt over the intro until the 3D scene is interactive.
findings.why: A visitor who arrives before the scene loads cannot tell what it is or what to do.

strengths: T-RIVAL-NAME / T-MIRROR / T-DEFAULT-AGENT all pass: a bespoke illustrated planet with its own architecture and palette; no stock sections, no SaaS chrome, no copy to swap.
Single teal ground with flat-shaded, outlined props gives the piece a consistent, authored visual voice.
not_investigated: Blocked script https://messenger.abeto.co/assets/App3D-DwM1eiaC.js (manifest network): the interactive world, UI buttons, emoji panel and checklist content did not render, so gameplay UI and any copy are not verified.
Motion and interaction (scripted clicks) not captured.
